title: Eustachian Tube Testing in a Pressure Chamber -- Validation Study
brief_summary: This study will compare Eustachian tube function (ETF) testing in adults with intact tympanic membranes (TM) using a pressure chamber to that obtained using standard methods requiring a non-intact TM.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>18 years old
* Normal middle-ear status

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic illness including asthma, pulmonary, or cardiac problems
* Pregnancy
* \>10 dB hearing loss in any of the speech frequencies
* Past history of sensitivity or allergic reaction to lidocaine or related compounds
